about_the_game:
This add-on content contains the following.

●BGM: Earth-Piercing Bolt - Rey Dau (Piano)
●BGM: Crested Torrent - Uth Duna (Piano)
●BGM: Ebon Hellfire - Nu Udra (Piano)
●BGM: The Lord of Ice - Jin Dahaad -Scowl- (Piano)

A set of 4 BGM with a beautiful piano arrangement.

Set and enjoy a variety of background music that has supported hunters throughout their hunting lives!

*You can change music by selecting Change BGM in the Tent Settings Menu in your tent.
*Background music during quests cannot be changed
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
